description: Fluffy and friends: a round plush mascot (real fur shells, big cartoon eyes, a grin, a backwards cap, denim shorts and sneakers) in seven looks, and the outfit props they use. Generated by tools/gen_fluffy.mjs: edit that, not this file.

fluffy.description: Fluffy: a round cream plush buddy with real fuzz, big brown eyes, thick brows and a wide grin, in a backwards red cap, denim shorts and red sneakers. Named parts: arm (mitten hands with thumbs), leg_left, leg_right, cap, shorts.

fluffy_smart.description: Smart Fluffy: Fluffy in a green cap and round glasses, holding an open book in both hands (reading, school, stories). Named parts: arm, book, glasses, cap, leg_left, leg_right.

fluffy_magic.description: Magic Fluffy: Fluffy as a little wizard, in a starry purple hat and cape, with a gold star wand in the left mitten (stories, magic, pretend play). Named parts: arm (the wand rides on it), hat, cape, leg_left, leg_right.

fluffy_sporty.description: Sporty Fluffy: Fluffy in a blue backwards cap and a blue number 1 jersey, a basketball in the left mitten (sports, games, counting points). Named parts: arm (the ball rides on it), jersey, cap, leg_left, leg_right.

fluffy_super.description: Super Fluffy: Fluffy as a superhero, with a blue eye mask, a red cape and a gold star on the chest (brave, helping, hero stories). Named parts: arm, mask, cape, star, cap, leg_left, leg_right.

yogurt_man.description: Yogurt Man: Fluffy's smooth friend with a soft, glossy yogurt-white body, a blue backwards cap, denim shorts and blue sneakers.

dumpling_buddy.description: Dumpling Buddy: Fluffy's friend shaped like a soft steamed dumpling with pleats on top, a yellow backwards cap, drawstring shorts and yellow sneakers.

basketball.description: An orange basketball with dark seams.

magic_wand.description: A wooden magic wand with a glowing gold star on top.

round_glasses.description: Round black reading glasses (on a head: parent the critter, part head).

wizard_hat.description: A floppy purple wizard hat with gold stars.

baseball_cap.description: A red baseball cap with a brim (turn it 180 degrees to wear it backwards).

eye_mask.description: A superhero eye mask with two eye holes.

hero_cape.description: A soft red hero cape (hang it on a critter's back).

star_badge.description: A shiny gold star badge (a hero's chest star, a sticker reward).
